en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a large artillery cannon with classical columns in the background. The top of the postcard features the label 'La « Batteria Battisti » sul Dos Trento'. Below the image, there's an Italian poem by Gabriele D'Annunzio and a block of explanatory text regarding the origin and presentation of the 'Batteria della Vendetta e della Vittoria' named after Cesare Battisti.
